scope: Vitis 2026.1 iicps_v3_23 polled receive path: propagate hardware TO and terminate receive polling after detecting it; preserve installed vendor source

behavior: XIicPs_MasterPolledRead 在 FIFO 服务后重读 ISR，并在 TO 等错误置位时停止普通轮询
Zynq 大读取 FIFO-full 等待检查错误，发现错误时不继续写下一段 Transfer Size
XIicPs_MasterRecvPolled 将 TO 计入最终失败判断；仲裁丢失返回语义不变

runtime_harness.tested_function: 从固定散列原件应用补丁后提取的真实 XIicPs_MasterPolledRead 函数体；MMIO、ISR、FIFO 和字节服务为 mock
runtime_harness.transfer_size_write_count_scope: 仅统计被测 MasterPolledRead 函数执行期间的写入，不包括 MasterRecvPolled 启动事务时设置的初始 Transfer Size。

initial_harness_attempt.cause: harness 对循环尾一次 ISR 读取计数预期少 1；首次失败证据保留。修正测试期望后，子代理及主控的独立新运行均通过。

independent_review.scope: 本任务冻结文件的只读审查；不代表 Vitis/BSP、实板或阶段门通过

semantics_and_constraints.hardware_to: UG585: TO is generated when SCL is held Low by master or slave beyond the Timeout register period; it is not a software wall-clock deadline
semantics_and_constraints.reset_timeout_value: The local Vitis driver reset sequence writes XIICPS_TO_RESET_VALUE 0xFF; this does not establish a millisecond deadline or guarantee recovery from every hang
semantics_and_constraints.zero_length_erratum: XA Zynq-7000 EN257: master read with HOLD=1 and Transfer Size=0 can transfer 16 extra bytes and corrupt Transfer Size when timeout expires; this patch does not remove the erratum. Project caller currently uses 1-byte reads; future callers must use positive ByteCount and avoid zero-byte HOLD reads.

limitations: 主机 harness mock 了 MMIO、ISR、FIFO 和字节服务；没有编译 Vitis BSP，也没有执行真实 MMIO/FIFO 操作。
不证明 Timeout 寄存器在最终 BSP 中的实际配置、有效硬件超时周期、模块接线或板上行为。
没有验证 IsRepeatedStart 非零时的 HOLD 错误恢复语义；BSP 集成前须核实实例选项并单独验证。
没有将 overlay 集成到当前 BSP；不得修改 Vitis 安装原件。
不是阶段 3 G0/G1/G2/G3/G4/G5 验收结论。
